verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI offers adaptive crawling that stops once enough information is gathered (foraging algorithm), deep-crawl with max-pages/BFS controls, and resume_state/checkpointing for long-running crawls — all of which let a developer trade off latency vs. completeness by controlling when/how much content is returned. However, there's no explicit streaming/early-return API or documented latency-vs-completeness benchmarks showing the tradeoff quantitatively. Missing for 10: explicit streaming or partial-result return mode, documented latency/completeness benchmarks, independent hands-on verification of the adaptive stopping behavior's accuracy.
